title: A step toward: Order 3 plane: no circuit of at most 64 AND/OR gates of fan-in two (distinct earlier wires) computes incidence and has a double re-read incidence (step 1 of 2)
statement: ∀ (x1 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), (∀ (x2 : ℕ) (x3 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate), x1.gates[x2]? = Option.some x3 → (x3.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∨ x3.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or) ∧ ∃ (x5 : ℕ) (x6 : ℕ), x3.inputs = [x5, x6] ∧ x5 ≠ x6 ∧ x5 < (26 : ℕ) + x2 ∧ x6 < (26 : ℕ) + x2) → (∀ (x3 : Fin (26 : ℕ) → Bool), x1.eval (List.ofFn x3) = Bool.true ↔ ∃ (x4 : Fin (13 : ℕ)) (x5 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), (x4 = x5 ∨ x4 = x5 + (1 : Fin (13 : ℕ)) ∨ x4 = x5 + (3 : Fin (13 : ℕ)) ∨ x4 = x5 + (9 : Fin (13 : ℕ))) ∧ x3 (Fin.castAdd (13 : ℕ) x4) = Bool.true ∧ x3 (Fin.natAdd (13 : ℕ) x5) = Bool.true) → (63 : ℕ) ≤ x1.size
unlocks: With its 1 sibling(s) it proves a posted step.
context: A hypothesis of a checked reduction, as Lean printed it.
sketch: Step 1 of 2 of a checked cut of L-meta-1482. Its sibling steps: L-meta-2602. Together they give the parent; the parent's own sketch: The exact least size at the plane of order 3: the star circuit has 64 gates. This side: no circuit of at most the stated size. SIZE, corrected 24 Nov: NOT a session-sized search by plain SAT; in-house controls show about eight times more time per gate (a 10-input case: 9 gates in 162 seconds, 12 gates unanswered in 3 minutes).
